import os,subprocess,collections
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/workspace/clay-global-research-entity')
subdirs=['research_entity','agentzeroforschung','research','docs']
for d in subdirs:
 base=root/d
 if not base.exists(): print('MISSING',d);continue
 files=[p for p in base.rglob('*') if p.is_file() and '.git' not in p.parts]
 extensions=collections.Counter(p.suffix.lower() for p in files)
 whitelisted=[p for p in files if p.suffix.lower() in ('.json','.md','.txt','.py','.csv','.yaml','.yml','.sql')]
 sizes=sum(p.stat().st_size for p in whitelisted)
 print('SOURCE',d,'files',len(files),'text_candidates',len(whitelisted),'bytes',sizes,'extensions',extensions.most_common(9))
git=subprocess.run(['git','-C',str(root),'rev-parse','HEAD'],capture_output=True,text=True)
print('SOURCE_HEAD',git.stdout.strip() if git.returncode==0 else 'UNKNOWN')
for item in ['/workspace/omega_runtime/data/omega_unified.db','/workspace/omega_runtime/data/omega_unified.db-wal']:
 p=Path(item);print('TARGET_FILE',p.name,p.stat().st_size if p.exists() else 'MISSING')
